skills.description: Turn an authorized engineering request into a scoped technical contract with observable acceptance checks.
Explain how an existing subsystem works or why it has its present shape using scoped source evidence.
Design caller contracts and state ownership before an interface, schema or tensor change locks in the wrong behavior.
Identify downstream consumers and invariants at risk from a proposed change and choose concrete verification targets.
Build behavior tests at public seams with expected results independent of the implementation, using small vertical changes.
Diagnose a reproducible defect or regression through competing hypotheses and discriminating experiments.
Evaluate performance hypotheses using a frozen representative benchmark and correctness gates before accepting an improvement.
Review an immutable candidate against intent and public contracts, producing evidence-backed findings without editing it.
Verify specified user flows in a browser independently of implementation and report observed behavior and artifacts.
Assemble revision-bound local delivery evidence and a proposed PR without publishing or merging.
